statement: Write a function that returns the nth Fibonacci number using memoization.
Write a function that checks whether a given string is a valid palindrome, ignoring non-alphanumeric characters and case.
Write a function that merges two sorted linked lists into one sorted linked list.
Write a function that finds all pairs in an array of integers that sum to a target value.
Write a function to detect if a directed graph contains a cycle, given an adjacency list.
Write a function that implements binary search on a sorted array.
Write a function that computes the longest common subsequence of two strings.
Write a function that flattens an arbitrarily nested list of lists into a single flat list.
Write a function that validates whether a given string of brackets is balanced.
Write a function implementing a basic LRU cache with get and put operations.
